_about: A. A. Milne's (1882-1956) children's books: Winnie-the-Pooh (1926), The House at Pooh Corner (1928), the verse of When We Were Very Young (1924) and Now We Are Six (1927), and his fairy story Once on a Time (1917). US public domain (published before 1929); NOT public domain in the UK and other life-plus-70 countries until 2027. Clean Gutenberg text. His plays, essays and detective novel are not taken.
